g.text: Crafty — image capture, immutable assets, and annotation lineage
assetId, projectId, kind, MIME, bytes, SHA-256
Storage key and temporary URL are not the asset identity.
Browser model snapshot records revision + GLB hash + camera pose.
FreeCAD renders reference their run and native geometry snapshot.
Annotation coordinates refer to normalized source pixels.
Flattened PNG is directly visible to the agent.
Keep the source unchanged; edits create another asset.
Message/interaction submission waits for all referenced assets to be ready.
A failed submission can reuse ready uploads with the same idempotency key.
Browser blob URLs and local file paths never become durable references.
Clearing the capture tray does not delete published conversation assets.
Attachment is a reference relationship; the asset itself remains ready.
verify size, format, hash; finalize blob
